Class LocomotiveRepository

java.lang.Object
repository.LocomotiveRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LocomotiveRepository extends Object implements Serializable
Repository class responsible for managing locomotive data and operations. This class handles the storage, retrieval, and purchase of locomotive objects within the application.

      public boolean addLocomotive(Locomotive locomotive)

    • addLocomotive

      public boolean addLocomotive(String modelName, int price, String type, int fuelCost, int maintenanceCost, int startYearOfOperation, int endYearOfOperation, int topSpeed)
      Creates and adds a new locomotive to the repository based on provided parameters.
      Parameters:
      modelName - Name/model of the locomotive
      price - Purchase price of the locomotive
      type - Type/category of the locomotive
      fuelCost - Cost of fuel for operating the locomotive
      maintenanceCost - Cost of maintaining the locomotive
      startYearOfOperation - Year when the locomotive started/starts operation
      endYearOfOperation - Year when the locomotive ended/ends operation
      topSpeed - Maximum speed of the locomotive
      Returns:
      true if the locomotive was added successfully, false if a locomotive with the same model name already exists

      true if a locomotive with the same model name exists, false otherwise

    • buyLocomotive

      public boolean buyLocomotive(Locomotive locomotive, Budget money, Scenario scenario)
      Processes the purchase of a locomotive for the current user. Checks if the user has sufficient budget and adds the locomotive to the user's collection.
      Parameters:
      locomotive - The locomotive to purchase
      money - The budget to use for the purchase
      Returns:
      true if the purchase was successful, false if insufficient funds

    • buyLocomotive

      public boolean buyLocomotive(String modelName, Budget money, Scenario scenario)
      Attempts to purchase a locomotive with the given model name using the provided budget and scenario. Retrieves the locomotive by its model name, checks if the purchase is valid, and completes the transaction if possible.
      Parameters:
      modelName - The name or model of the locomotive to purchase
      money - The budget available for the purchase
      scenario - The current scenario in which the purchase is being made
      Returns:
      true if the locomotive was successfully purchased, false otherwise
